ruling: 13 Nov: the video no longer says the story is fiction; the caption does

cut.text: Kathang-isip: ang mundong walang unang pagpatay, ang sanggol, at kami ni Usman.

keep_with_the_word.text: Sa ibaba ng bawat marker, maliit na sulat: tiyak, pinagtatalunan, kathang-isip.
keep_with_the_word.why: Plot. The heroes' method is written on every marker in the rebuilt world. The ruling names it as a keep.

keep_with_the_word.text: Walang anak si Abel na binanggit sa Bibliya, at sa talatang dalawampu't lima, si Set ang ibang anak na kahalili ni Abel.
keep_with_the_word.why: A fact about scripture as written. It already tells the viewer that Abel's baby is not in the Bible, so no re-voice is needed.

after_cut: Walang anak si Abel na binanggit sa Bibliya, at sa talatang dalawampu't lima, si Set ang ibang anak na kahalili ni Abel. / Kaya ikaw, ka-Indio, i-comment mo: ano ang unang marker na babasahin mo nang malakas?
